subject: BUG: --fd-text-3 fails WCAG 4.5:1 on all FD backgrounds -- fix: #7D8590
body:
BUG: FD design token --fd-text-3 fails WCAG 1.4.3 on all backgrounds

Filed by: GD QA pass on FD redesign tokens (Feb 2026)
Priority: Medium

FINDING
index.html :root (FD Design Tokens, Feb 2026 redesign):
  --fd-text-3: #6E7681

Contrast against FD backgrounds:
  #6E7681 on --fd-bg (#0d1117): 4.12:1  FAIL (need 4.5:1 for normal text)
  #6E7681 on --fd-card (#161b22): 3.77:1 FAIL
  #6E7681 on --fd-raised (#1c2128): 3.52:1 FAIL

WHERE IT IS USED (all fail):
  .tc-date { font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--fd-text-3); }   -- test dates
  .tc-attempt { font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--fd-text-3); } -- attempt labels
  .trend-hd-r { font-size: 0.73rem; color: var(--fd-text-3); } -- chart header
  .tc-rib footer border-top area  -- metadata strip
  Empty state text (0.85rem)

All uses are at or below 12px. WCAG 1.4.3 AA requires 4.5:1 for normal (non-large) text.
These are not decorative -- they convey date, attempt count, and context to Kai and Marcus.

SECONDARY FINDING: Border tokens fail WCAG 1.4.11 (non-text contrast, 3:1):
  --fd-border (rgba 7% white) blended on fd-card: ~1.21:1 FAIL
  --fd-border2 (rgba 14% white) blended on fd-card: ~1.54:1 FAIL
Note on borders: Card borders that are ONLY decorative (no interactive meaning) may be exempt under WCAG 1.4.11.
These borders define card boundaries on a UI that navigates to those cards. Likely not exempt.
However, the fix is more complex (it would change the FD design aesthetic). Flag for FD decision.

FIX FOR fd-text-3 (simple, non-breaking):
Change: --fd-text-3: #6E7681;
To:     --fd-text-3: #7D8590;
Rationale: #7D8590 is same grey-blue hue, 5 lightness steps brighter.
  On fd-card: 4.64:1 PASS
  On fd-bg:   5.07:1 PASS
  On fd-raised: 4.32:1 -- marginal, check if fd-text-3 ever appears on fd-raised bg directly.

Visually: still reads as clearly subdued vs --fd-text-2 (#8B949E). The hierarchy is maintained.
The change is 7 hex characters. Should not require a design review by FD, but CC'd in case.

ACCEPT CRITERIA
- #6E7681 replaced with #7D8590 in index.html :root FD token block
- No other changes to layout or structure
- After change: spot-check test card dates are still visually subdued vs primary text

BORDER NOTE: defer to FD on whether --fd-border and --fd-border2 values need adjustment.
GD recommendation: at minimum, document that these are intentionally decorative and exempted.
